units.zh: 慕容皝
units.en: Murong Huang.

units.zh: 慕容皝，字元真，廆第三子也。
units.en: Murong Huang, whose courtesy name was Yuanzhen, was Murong Hui’s third son.

units.zh: 龍顏版齒，身長七尺八寸。
units.en: He had a dragon countenance and plaque-like teeth, and stood seven chi eight cun tall.

units.zh: 雄毅多權略，尚經學，善天文。
units.en: He was bold, resourceful, devoted to the classics, and adept at reading the stars.

units.zh: 廆為遼東公，立為世子。
units.en: When Murong Hui was named duke of Liaodong, Huang was made his heir.

units.zh: 建武初，拜為冠軍將軍、左賢王，封望平侯，率眾征討，累有功。
units.en: Early in the Jianwu era he was named general who champions the army and left worthy prince, created marquis of Wangping, and led troops on several successful expeditions.

units.zh: 太甯末，拜平北將軍，進封朝鮮公。
units.en: Late in the Taining era he became general who pacifies the north and was promoted to duke of Chaoxian.

units.zh: 廆卒，嗣位，以平北將軍行平州刺史，督攝部內。
units.en: When Hui died he succeeded him, serving as general who pacifies the north and acting governor of Pingzhou with authority over the whole command.

units.zh: 尋而宇文乞得龜為其別部逸豆歸所逐，奔死於外，皝率騎討之，逸豆歸懼而請和，遂築榆陰、安晉二城而還。
units.en: Soon afterward Yuwen Qidegui was driven out by Yidougui of his separate division and died in exile; Huang led cavalry against Yidougui, who took fright and sued for peace; Huang then built the two cities of Yuyin and Anjin and withdrew.

units.zh: 初，皝庶兄建威翰驍武有雄才，素為皝所忌，母弟征虜仁、廣武昭並有寵於廆，皝亦不平之。
units.en: Earlier, Huang's elder half-brother Murong Han, general who establishes might, was brave in arms and of heroic talent, and Huang had long resented him. Huang's younger full brothers Murong Ren, general who campaigns against the caitiffs, and Murong Zhao, general who extends martial power, were both favored by Hui, which also displeased Huang.

units.zh: 及廆卒，並懼不自容。
units.en: When Hui died they all feared for their lives.

units.zh: 至此，翰出奔段遼，仁勸昭舉兵廢皝。
units.en: Murong Han fled to Duan Liao, while Murong Ren urged Murong Zhao to revolt and depose Huang.

units.zh: 皝殺昭，遣使按檢仁之虛實，遇仁於險瀆。
units.en: Huang executed Zhao and sent envoys to probe whether Ren’s situation was genuine; they encountered Ren at Xiandu.

units.zh: 仁知事發，殺皝使，東歸平郭。
units.en: Ren knew the affair had come out; he killed Huang’s envoy and returned east to Pingguo.

units.zh: 皝遣其弟建武幼、司馬佟壽等討之。
units.en: Huang dispatched his younger brother Murong You, general who establishes martial power, Marshal Tong Shou, and others to campaign against Ren.

units.zh: 仁盡眾距戰，幼等大敗，皆沒於仁。
units.en: Ren threw his whole army into the fight and crushed You’s force, capturing every commander.

units.zh: 襄平令王冰、將軍孫機以遼東叛於皝，東夷校尉封抽、護軍乙逸、遼東相韓矯、玄菟太守高詡等棄城奔還。
units.en: Xiangping magistrate Wang Bing and general Sun Ji rebelled in Liaodong against Huang; Eastern Yi Colonel Feng Chou, Protector Yi Yi, Liaodong chancellor Han Jiao, Xuantu prefect Gao Xu, and others abandoned their cities and fled back.

units.zh: 仁於是盡有遼左之地，自稱車騎將軍、平州刺史、遼東公。
units.en: Ren then controlled all territory east of the Liao, proclaiming himself general of chariots and cavalry, governor of Pingzhou, and duke of Liaodong.

units.zh: 宇文歸、段遼及鮮卑諸部並為之援，
units.en: Yuwen Gui, Duan Liao, and the various Xianbei divisions all backed him.

units.zh: 咸和九年，皝遣其司馬封弈攻鮮卑木堤于白狼，揚威淑虞攻烏丸悉羅侯于平岡，皆斬之。
units.en: In the ninth year of Xianhe, Huang sent his marshal Feng Yi to attack the Xianbei Muti at Bailang, and the Yangwei general Shuyu to attack the Wuhuan Siluohou at Pinggang; both were beheaded.

units.zh: 材官劉佩攻乙連，不克。
units.en: Engineering officer Liu Pei assaulted Yilian without success.

units.zh: 遼弟蘭與翰寇柳城，都尉石琮擊敗之。
units.en: Liao’s younger brother Lan together with Han raided Liucheng; commandant Shi Cong struck and defeated them.

units.zh: 旬余，蘭、翰復圍柳城，皝遣甯遠慕容汗及封弈等救之。
units.en: Ten-odd days later Duan Lan and Murong Han, the kinsman who had joined Duan Liao, again besieged Liucheng; Huang sent the Ningyuan general, a different Murong Han, together with Feng Yi and others to relieve the city.

units.zh: 皝戒汗曰：「賊眾氣銳，難與爭鋒，宜顧萬全，慎勿輕進，必須兵集陣整，然後擊之。」
units.en: Huang warned Han, saying: “The bandits’ host is numerous and their spirit keen; it is hard to contend at the spear-tip. You ought to look to complete safety, and carefully do not advance lightly; you must wait until the troops are gathered and the lines set, then strike them.”

units.zh: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
units.en: That year Emperor Cheng sent the envoys Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others with credentials to invest Huang as General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with credentials, overall command, and authority to enfeoff by mandate, as Hui had held.

units.zh: 皝自征遼東，克襄平。
units.en: Huang led the army in person and captured Xiangping.

units.zh: 仁所署居就令劉程以城降，新昌人張衡執縣宰以降。
units.en: Liu Cheng, whom Ren had installed at Juqiu, yielded the town, while Zhang Heng of Xinchang seized the magistrate and capitulated.

units.zh: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
units.en: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and marched home.

units.en: Han’s nature was fierce and keen; he dispatched over a thousand cavalry as a vanguard to advance; Feng Yi stopped him, but Han did not follow, was defeated by Lan, and the dead were more than half.

units.zh: 蘭復攻柳城，為飛梯、地道，圍守二旬，石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之，斬首千五百級，蘭乃遁歸。
units.en: Duan Lan attacked Liucheng again, using flying ladders and tunnels, and kept up the siege for twenty days; Shi Cong personally led his officers and men out to strike, defeated him, and took fifteen hundred heads, and Lan then fled home.

units.zh: 咸康初，遣封弈襲宇文別部涉奕於，大獲而還。
units.en: Early in Xiankang he sent Feng Yi against Sheyiyu of a separate Yuwen division and returned with rich spoils.

units.zh: 涉奕于率騎追戰于渾水，又敗之。
units.en: Sheyiyu led cavalry in pursuit and fought at the Hun River, and was defeated again.

units.zh: 皝將乘海討仁，群下咸諫，以海道危陰，宜從陸路。
units.en: When Huang planned a seaborne strike on Ren, his advisers objected that the route was too perilous and urged a march by land.

units.zh: 皝曰：「舊海水無淩，自仁反已來，凍合者三矣。
units.en: Huang said, “Formerly the sea water had no ice; since Ren’s rebellion, the freeze has joined three times.

units.zh: 昔漢光武因滹沱之冰以濟大業，天其或者欲吾乘此而無之乎！
units.en: Han Guangwu once crossed the Hutuo on the ice to win his empire—Heaven may mean me to use this freeze against Ren!

units.zh: 吾計決矣，有沮謀者斬！」
units.en: My mind is made up; anyone who dissuades me dies!”

units.zh: 乃率三軍從昌黎踐淩而進。
units.en: He then marched the host across the frozen bay from Changli.

units.zh: 仁不虞皝之至也，軍去平郭七里，候騎乃告，仁狼狽出戰，為皝所擒，殺仁而還。
units.en: Ren did not expect Huang’s arrival; the army was seven li from Pingguo when scout riders reported it; Ren came out to fight in confusion, was captured by Huang, who killed Ren and returned.

units.zh: 立藉田於朝陽門東，置官司以主之。
units.en: He set aside a ritual field east of the Chaoyang Gate and staffed it with officials.

units.zh: 皝以步騎五萬擊之，師次柳城，蘭、歸皆遁。
units.en: Huang met them with fifty thousand foot and horse; Lan and Gui both fled when the army halted at Liucheng.

units.zh: 遣封弈率輕騎追擊，敗之，收其軍實，館穀二旬而還。
units.en: He sent Feng Yi leading light cavalry in pursuit; Feng defeated them, gathered their military stores, lodged on their grain for twenty days, and returned.

units.zh: 謂諸將曰：「二虜恥無功而歸，必復重至，宜於柳城左右設伏以待之。」
units.en: He told his commanders, “They will return in force to save face—we should lay ambushes around Liucheng.”

units.zh: 遣封弈率騎潛于馬兒山諸道。
units.en: Feng Yi hid cavalry along the Ma’er Mountain tracks.

units.zh: 俄而遼騎果至，弈夾擊，大敗之，斬其將榮保。
units.en: When Duan Liao’s riders appeared, Feng Yi caught them in a pincer, slew Rong Bao, and routed the column.

units.zh: 使其世子俊伐段遼諸城，封弈攻宇文別部，皆大捷而歸。
units.en: He had his heir apparent Jun campaign against Duan Liao’s cities, and Feng Yi attack a separate Yuwen division; both returned in great victory.

units.zh: 後徙昌黎郡，築好城于乙連東，使將軍蘭勃戍之，以逼乙連。
units.en: He later relocated Changli commandery, built Haocheng east of Yilian, and had general Lan Bo garrison it to press Yilian.

units.zh: 遼遣將屈雲攻興國，與皝將慕容遵大戰于五官水上，雲敗，斬之，盡俘其眾。
units.en: Liao sent general Qu Yun to attack Xingguo; Yun fought a great battle with Huang’s general Murong Zun at Wuguan River, was defeated and beheaded, and his entire force was captured.

units.zh: 封弈等以皝任重位輕，宜稱燕王，皝於是以咸康三年僭即王位，赦其境內。
units.en: Feng Yi and others, holding that Huang’s burden was heavy while his rank was light, urged him to style himself King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed the kingship and pardoned those within his borders.

units.zh: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
units.en: He named Feng Yi state chancellor and Han Shou marshal, and appointed Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others as ministers and generals.

units.zh: 皝以段遼屢為邊患，遣將軍宋回稱籓于石季龍，請師討遼。
units.en: Troubled by Duan Liao, he sent Song Hui to submit to Shi Hu and beg for an allied expedition.

units.zh: 皝率諸軍攻遼令支以北諸城，遼遣其將段蘭來距，大戰，敗之，斬級數千，掠五千餘戶而歸。
units.en: Huang stormed Duan Liao’s strongholds north of Lingzhi, crushed Duan Lan, took thousands of heads, and carried off more than five thousand households.

units.zh: 季龍進入令支，怒皝之不會師也，進軍擊之，至於棘城，戎卒數十萬，四面進攻，郡縣諸部叛應季龍者三十六城。
units.en: Shi Hu entered Lingzhi, furious that Huang had not joined forces, advanced to strike him as far as Jicheng; several hundred thousand troops attacked from all four sides, and thirty-six cities among the prefectures, counties, and various divisions rebelled in response to Shi Hu.

units.zh: 皝曰：「孤方取天下，何乃降人乎！」
units.en: Huang snapped, “I mean to seize the realm—why would I surrender?”

units.zh: 帝又遣使進皝為征北大將軍、幽州牧，領平州刺史，加散騎常侍，增邑萬戶，持節、都督、單于、公如故。
units.en: The emperor again sent envoys to advance Huang as General Who Campaigns North, shepherd of You Province, concurrently governor of Ping Province, adding Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and an increase of ten thousand households, with credentials, overall command, shanyu, and duke as before.

units.en: Duan Liao sent general Li Yong to night-raid Wuxing; meeting rain, he withdrew; commandant Zhang Meng pursued and captured Yong.

units.zh: 段蘭擁眾數萬屯於曲水亭，將攻柳城，宇文歸入寇安晉，為蘭聲援。
units.en: Duan Lan massed tens of thousands at Qushui to strike Liucheng while Yuwen Gui hit Anjin in coordination.

units.zh: 皝以步騎五萬擊之，師次柳城，蘭、歸皆遁。
units.en: Huang met them with fifty thousand foot and horse; Lan and Gui both fled when the army halted at Liucheng.

units.zh: 遣封弈率輕騎追擊，敗之，收其軍實，館穀二旬而還。
units.en: He sent Feng Yi leading light cavalry in pursuit; Feng defeated them, gathered their military stores, lodged on their grain for twenty days, and returned.

units.zh: 謂諸將曰：「二虜恥無功而歸，必復重至，宜於柳城左右設伏以待之。」
units.en: He told his commanders, “They will return in force to save face—we should lay ambushes around Liucheng.”

units.zh: 遣封弈率騎潛于馬兒山諸道。
units.en: Feng Yi hid cavalry along the Ma’er Mountain tracks.

units.zh: 俄而遼騎果至，弈夾擊，大敗之，斬其將榮保。
units.en: When Duan Liao’s riders appeared, Feng Yi caught them in a pincer, slew Rong Bao, and routed the column.

units.zh: 遣兼長史劉斌、郎中令陽景送徐孟等歸於京師。
units.en: He sent concurrent chief clerk Liu Bin and palace director Yang Jing to escort Xu Meng and others back to the capital.

units.zh: 使其世子俊伐段遼諸城，封弈攻宇文別部，皆大捷而歸。
units.en: He had his heir apparent Jun campaign against Duan Liao’s cities, and Feng Yi attack a separate Yuwen division; both returned in great victory.

units.zh: 立納諫之木，以開讜言之路。
units.en: He erected a public complaint board to invite candid advice.

units.zh: 後徙昌黎郡，築好城于乙連東，使將軍蘭勃戍之，以逼乙連。
units.en: He later relocated Changli commandery, built Haocheng east of Yilian, and had general Lan Bo garrison it to press Yilian.

units.zh: 又城曲水，以為勃援。
units.en: He fortified Qushui to back Lan Bo.

units.zh: 乙連饑甚，段遼輸之粟，蘭勃要擊獲之。
units.en: When Yilian starved, Duan Liao sent grain; Lan Bo seized the convoy.

units.zh: 遼遣將屈雲攻興國，與皝將慕容遵大戰于五官水上，雲敗，斬之，盡俘其眾。
units.en: Liao sent general Qu Yun to attack Xingguo; Yun fought a great battle with Huang’s general Murong Zun at Wuguan River, was defeated and beheaded, and his entire force was captured.

units.zh: 封弈等以皝任重位輕，宜稱燕王，皝於是以咸康三年僭即王位，赦其境內。
units.en: Feng Yi and others, holding that Huang’s burden was heavy while his rank was light, urged him to style himself King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed the kingship and pardoned those within his borders.

units.zh: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
units.en: He named Feng Yi state chancellor and Han Shou marshal, and appointed Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others as ministers and generals.

units.zh: 起文昌殿，乘金根車，駕六馬，出入稱警蹕。
units.en: He built Wenchang Hall, rode the six-horse imperial carriage, and received full royal escorts.

units.zh: 以其妻段氏為王后，世子俊為太子，皆如魏武、晉文輔政故事。
units.en: He made his wife Lady Duan queen and the heir apparent Jun crown prince, all following the Wei Wu and Jin Wen precedents of assisting in government.

units.zh: 皝以段遼屢為邊患，遣將軍宋回稱籓于石季龍，請師討遼。
units.en: Troubled by Duan Liao, he sent Song Hui to submit to Shi Hu and beg for an allied expedition.

units.zh: 皝率諸軍攻遼令支以北諸城，遼遣其將段蘭來距，大戰，敗之，斬級數千，掠五千餘戶而歸。
units.en: Huang stormed Duan Liao’s strongholds north of Lingzhi, crushed Duan Lan, took thousands of heads, and carried off more than five thousand households.

units.zh: 季龍至徐無，遼奔密雲山。
units.en: Shi Hu reached Xuwu while Duan Liao fled into Miyun Mountain.

units.zh: 段遼遣使詐降于季龍，請兵應接。
units.en: Duan Liao feigned submission to Shi Hu and asked for an escort.

units.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
units.en: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.

value.event: Competing source readings are retained; no single historical year is selected. Haedong Yoksa, a later Joseon compilation explicitly citing Jinshu, files this campaign under Xiankang 3 (337) and notes that Tongjian has year 5. It is evidence for a later chronological arrangement, not independent contemporary testimony. Tongjian explicitly places the campaign and Zhao's request for a covenant under Xiankang 5 (339). Samguk Sagi assigns the campaign to Gogugwon year 9, giving 339 on the accession-in-331 synchronization stated in Haedong's note, which itself relies on the Korean history. The campaign wording closely parallels Tongjian and Jinshu; this alone does not establish direct borrowing or independent corroboration, so these accounts are not counted as multiple independent confirmations. Jinshu's unresolved 其年 follows a narrative insertion concerning Yu Liang's death and the memorial/letter leading to recognition of Huang. Taking the death notice as the narrative year's anchor gives a possible 340 alignment; taking the recognition episode as its anchor gives a possible 341 alignment, since Tongjian dates the formal grant to 341. These are distinct antecedent/alignment hypotheses, not a claim that a campaign after the 341 grant could occur in 340. The 337-341 interval is the inclusive envelope of these reported or conditional readings, not continuous campaigning or support for every intervening year. Literal 其年 remains unexpanded.

Competing source readings are retained; no single historical year is selected. Jinshu dates the heir's homage only 明年, the year following the disputed campaign. Haedong Yoksa, a later Joseon compilation explicitly citing Jinshu rather than independent contemporary testimony, places the campaign in Xiankang 3 (337) and appends 明年, implying homage in 338. Samguk Sagi explicitly records the heir's homage in Gogugwon year 10, giving 340 on the accession-in-331 synchronization stated in Haedong's note, which relies on the Korean history. Tongjian volume 96 explicitly dates the campaign to 339 but does not explicitly record this heir's homage in its 340 section. Thus 340 is both Samguk's express regnal-year placement and a next-year inference from Tongjian's campaign date combined with Jinshu's relative sequence; it is not an express Tongjian homage entry. Shared campaign wording among the histories does not establish direct textual dependence or independence of the separate homage notice, so no independent corroboration is claimed. If Jinshu's campaign 其年 is instead aligned with the death notice in 340, 明年 gives 341; if aligned with the recognition episode dated 341 in Tongjian, it gives 342. These are separate narrative-alignment hypotheses, not a campaign in 340 after a formal grant in 341. The 338-342 interval is an inclusive envelope of alternative readings, not a continuous homage event or express support for every intervening year. Literal 明年 and its one-year relationship to the campaign are retained.

units.zh: 季龍於是總眾而至。
units.en: Shi Hu thereupon marched his whole host to join the war.

units.zh: 皝率諸軍攻遼令支以北諸城，遼遣其將段蘭來距，大戰，敗之，斬級數千，掠五千餘戶而歸。

units.zh: 季龍至徐無，遼奔密雲山。
units.en: Shi Hu reached Xuwu while Duan Liao fled into Miyun Mountain.

units.zh: 季龍進入令支，怒皝之不會師也，進軍擊之，至於棘城，戎卒數十萬，四面進攻，郡縣諸部叛應季龍者三十六城。
units.en: Shi Hu entered Lingzhi, furious that Huang had not joined forces, advanced to strike him as far as Jicheng; several hundred thousand troops attacked from all four sides, and thirty-six cities among the prefectures, counties, and various divisions rebelled in response to Shi Hu.

units.zh: 相持旬餘，左右勸皝降。
units.en: After a fortnight’s siege his officers begged him to yield.

units.zh: 皝曰：「孤方取天下，何乃降人乎！」
units.en: Huang snapped, “I mean to seize the realm—why would I surrender?”

units.zh: 遣子恪等率騎二千，晨出擊之。
units.en: He sent his son Ke and others with two thousand horse in a dawn sally.

units.zh: 季龍諸軍驚擾，棄甲而遁。
units.en: Shi Hu’s host panicked and bolted, leaving their armor.

units.zh: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
units.en: Murong Ke pressed the victory in pursuit, killed or captured over thirty thousand, built a garrison at Fancheng, and returned.

units.zh: 段遼遣使詐降于季龍，請兵應接。
units.en: Duan Liao feigned submission to Shi Hu and asked for an escort.

units.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
units.en: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.

units.zh: 帝又遣使進皝為征北大將軍、幽州牧，領平州刺史，加散騎常侍，增邑萬戶，持節、都督、單于、公如故。
units.en: The emperor again sent envoys to advance Huang as General Who Campaigns North, shepherd of You Province, concurrently governor of Ping Province, adding Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and an increase of ten thousand households, with credentials, overall command, shanyu, and duke as before.

units.zh: 皝前軍帥慕容評敗季龍將石成等於遼西，斬其將呼延晃、張支，掠千餘戶以歸。
units.en: Huang’s forward commander Murong Ping defeated Shi Hu’s generals Shi Cheng and others in Liaoxi, slew Huyan Huang and Zhang Zhi, and brought home more than a thousand households.

units.zh: 段遼謀叛，皝誅之。
units.en: When Duan Liao plotted revolt, Huang put him to death.

units.zh: 季龍又使石成入攻凡城，不克，進陷廣城。
units.en: Shi Hu again sent Shi Cheng against Fancheng without success but seized Guangcheng.

units.zh: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
units.en: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, explain his provisional assumption of authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plain.

units.zh: 又聞庾亮薨，弟冰、翼繼為將相，乃表曰：臣究觀前代昏明之主，若能親賢並建，則功致升平；
units.en: Moreover, when Murong Huang learned that Yu Liang had died and Yu Bing and Yu Yi had succeeded as generals and ministers, he submitted a memorial: Your servant has closely observed the muddled and clear rulers of former ages; if they could treat the worthy with intimacy and elevate them together, then merit reached peaceful ascendancy;

units.zh: 若親黨后族，必有傾辱之禍。
units.en: when they favored kin and the empress's clan, overthrow and humiliation were sure to follow.

units.zh: 是以周之申伯號稱賢舅，以其身籓於外，不握朝權。
units.en: Shen Bo of Zhou was praised as a worthy maternal uncle because he held a frontier fief and did not grasp court power.

units.zh: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
units.en: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.

units.zh: 其年皝伐高句麗，王釗乞盟而還。
units.en: That year he invaded Goguryeo; King Gao Zhao begged a covenant and he withdrew.

units.zh: 明年，釗遣其世子朝於皝。
units.en: The next year Gao Zhao sent his heir to pay homage to Huang.

units.zh: 初，段遼之敗也，建威翰奔于宇文歸，自以威名夙振，終不保全，乃陽狂恣酒，被髮歌呼。
units.en: After Duan Liao’s fall Murong Han fled to Yuwen Gui, reckoned his fame would never let him live, and feigned madness—drinking, singing, and disheveled hair.

units.zh: 歸信而不禁，故得周遊自任，至於山川形便，攻戰要路，莫不練之。
units.en: Yuwen Gui believed the act and did not restrain him, so Han could roam at will and became thoroughly familiar with the terrain and the key routes for attack and battle.

units.zh: 皝遣商人王車陰使察翰，翰見車無言，撫膺而已。
units.en: Huang sent the trader Wang Che to spy; Murong Han met him in silence, only clutching his chest.

units.zh: 車還以白，皝曰：「翰欲來也。」
units.en: Wang Che reported the sign; Huang said, “He wants to come home.”

units.zh: 乃遣車遺翰弓矢，翰乃竊歸駿馬，攜其二子而還。
units.en: He sent Wang Che with a bow and arrows; Murong Han stole horses and rode back with his two sons.

units.zh: 皝將圖石氏，從容謂諸將曰：「石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重，城之南北必不設備，今若詭路出其不意，冀之北土盡可破也。」
units.en: Huang was about to plan against the Shi clan; he calmly told the generals: “Shi Hu thinks the cities of Anle and the rest are strictly and heavily guarded, and surely sets no defenses north and south of the city; now if we take a deceitful route and strike where he does not expect, the whole northern territory of Ji can be broken.”

units.zh: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
units.en: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.

units.zh: 封弈等以皝任重位輕，宜稱燕王，皝於是以咸康三年僭即王位，赦其境內。
units.en: Feng Yi and others, holding that Huang’s burden was heavy while his rank was light, urged him to style himself King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed the kingship and pardoned those within his borders.

units.zh: 段遼謀叛，皝誅之。
units.en: When Duan Liao plotted revolt, Huang put him to death.

units.zh: 季龍又使石成入攻凡城，不克，進陷廣城。
units.en: Shi Hu again sent Shi Cheng against Fancheng without success but seized Guangcheng.

units.zh: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
units.en: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, explain his provisional assumption of authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plain.

units.zh: 又聞庾亮薨，弟冰、翼繼為將相，乃表曰：臣究觀前代昏明之主，若能親賢並建，則功致升平；
units.en: Moreover, when Murong Huang learned that Yu Liang had died and Yu Bing and Yu Yi had succeeded as generals and ministers, he submitted a memorial: Your servant has closely observed the muddled and clear rulers of former ages; if they could treat the worthy with intimacy and elevate them together, then merit reached peaceful ascendancy;

units.zh: 若親黨后族，必有傾辱之禍。
units.en: when they favored kin and the empress's clan, overthrow and humiliation were sure to follow.

units.zh: 是以周之申伯號稱賢舅，以其身籓於外，不握朝權。
units.en: Shen Bo of Zhou was praised as a worthy maternal uncle because he held a frontier fief and did not grasp court power.

units.zh: 降及秦昭，足為令主，委信二舅，幾至亂國。
units.en: Even King Zhao of Qin, a capable ruler, trusted his two maternal uncles and nearly ruined the state.

units.zh: 逮于漢武，推重田蚡，萬機之要，無不決之。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Han elevated Tian Fen until every vital decision passed through him.

units.zh: 及蚡死後，切齒追恨。
units.en: After Fen died, the emperor gnashed his teeth in bitter regret.

units.zh: 成帝暗弱，不能自立，內惑豔妻，外恣五舅，卒令王莽坐取帝位。
units.en: Emperor Cheng was weak and could not stand alone; beguiled within by a beautiful consort and indulging the five maternal uncles without, he finally let Wang Mang seize the throne without effort.

units.zh: 每覽斯事，孰不痛惋！
units.en: Reading such cases, who does not feel pain and regret!

units.zh: 設使舅氏賢若穰侯、王鳳，則但聞有二臣，不聞有二主。
units.en: If maternal uncles were worthy like the Marquis of Rang or Wang Feng, one would hear of two ministers, not two rulers.

units.zh: 若其不才，則有竇憲、梁冀之禍。
units.en: If they lacked talent, disasters like those of Dou Xian and Liang Ji followed.

units.zh: 凡此成敗，亦既然矣。
units.en: The lesson of these successes and failures is already plain.

units.zh: 苟能易軌，可無覆墜。
units.en: If one could change course, overturn and collapse can be avoided.

units.zh: 陛下命世天挺，當隆晉道，而遭國多難，殷憂備嬰，追述往事，至今楚灼。
units.en: Your Majesty is heaven-born to the age, destined to exalt Jin's Way, yet has encountered many hardships of state; deep grief presses on every side, and recalling past affairs still burns with anguish to this day.

units.zh: 跡其所由，實因故司空亮居元舅之尊，勢業之重，執政裁下，輕侮邊將，故令蘇峻、祖約不勝其忿，遂致敗國。
units.en: Tracing where it came from, it was truly because the late Minister of Works Yu Liang occupied the honor of chief maternal uncle and the weight of power and achievement, governed and judged subordinates, and lightly insulted frontier generals, so that Su Jun and Zu Yue could not contain their rage and thus brought disaster on the state.

units.zh: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
units.en: And now the Empress Dowager, overcome with indignation, has suddenly passed away.

units.zh: 若社稷不靈，人神無助，豺狼之心當可極邪！
units.en: Had the altars not been numinous and men and spirits not aided us, would the hearts of wolves and jackals have been allowed to run their course!

units.zh: 前事不忘，後事之表，而中書監、左將軍冰等內執樞機，外擁上將，昆弟並列，人臣莫疇。
units.en: Past events, if not forgotten, are a model for later affairs; yet Yu Bing, Director of the Secretariat and General of the Left, and his fellows grasp the pivot within and hold senior military commands outside; the brothers stand side by side, with no other minister to match them.

units.zh: 陛下深敦渭陽，冰等自宜引領。
units.en: Your Majesty deeply honors the ties of Weiyang; Bing and his fellows ought themselves to stretch their necks in expectation.

units.zh: 臣常謂世主若欲崇顯舅氏，何不封以籓國，豐其祿賜，限其勢利，使上無偏優，下無私論。
units.en: Your servant often says: if a ruler of the age wishes to honor the maternal clan, why not enfeoff them with vassal states, enrich their stipends and gifts, and limit their power and advantage, so that above there is no partial favor and below no private talk.

units.zh: 如此，榮辱何從而生！
units.en: Then whence would honor or disgrace arise!

units.zh: 噂𠴲何辭而起！
units.en: Whence would slander spring!

units.zh: 往者惟亮一人，宿有名望，尚致世變，況今居之者素無聞焉！
units.en: Formerly Yu Liang alone, though long renowned, still brought turmoil; how much more those who hold power today and were never heard of before!

units.zh: 且人情易惑，難以戶告，縱今陛下無私于彼，天下之人誰謂不私乎！
units.en: Human feelings are easily swayed and cannot be told house to house; even if Your Majesty is impartial, who in the realm will believe it!

units.zh: 臣與冰等名位殊班，出處懸邈，又國之戚昵，理應降悅，以適事會。
units.en: Your servant and Bing and the others differ in rank and status and are far apart in our situations; moreover, they are close kin of the imperial house. By rights I ought to defer and accommodate myself to the circumstances.

units.zh: 臣獨矯抗此言者，上為陛下，退為冰計，疾苟容之臣，坐鑒得失。
units.en: I speak against the tide alone: for Your Majesty above and for Bing's sake below, hating ministers who only flatter and judging gain and loss plainly.

units.zh: 顛而不扶，焉用彼相！
units.en: If one does not right what is overturned, of what use is that minister!

units.zh: 昔徐福陳霍氏之戒，宣帝不從，至令忠臣更為逆族，良由察之不審，防之無漸。
units.en: Formerly Xu Fu warned against the Huo clan; Emperor Xuan did not heed him, and loyal ministers became a traitorous house because he did not examine carefully or guard against gradual encroachment.

units.zh: 臣今所陳，可謂防漸矣。
units.en: What I now set forth is prevention at the first sign.

units.zh: 但恐陛下不明臣之忠，不用臣之計，事過之日，更處焦爛之後耳。
units.en: I fear only that Your Majesty may not see my loyalty or use my plan, and that after disaster passes you will again stand amid the ashes.

units.zh: 昔王章、劉向每上封事，未嘗不指斥王氏，故令二子或死或刑。
units.en: Formerly Wang Zhang and Liu Xiang denounced the Wang clan in every sealed memorial and ended dead or punished.

units.zh: 谷永、張禹依違不對，故容身苟免，取譏於世。
units.en: Gu Yong and Zhang Yu equivocated and preserved themselves, winning only the age's ridicule.

units.zh: 臣被髮殊俗，位為上將，夙夜惟憂，罔知所報，惟當外殄寇仇，內盡忠規，陳力輸誠，以答國恩。
units.en: I wear my hair loose and follow different customs, hold the rank of supreme general, worry day and night and know not how to repay, and can only destroy enemies abroad, exhaust loyal remonstrance within, and exert strength and offer sincerity to answer the state's grace.

units.zh: 臣若不言，誰當言者！
units.en: If I do not speak, who will!

units.zh: 又與冰書曰：君以椒房之親，舅氏之昵，總據樞機，出內王命，兼擁列將州司之位，昆弟網羅，顯布畿甸。
units.en: He also wrote to Yu Bing: By empress kinship and maternal closeness you hold the pivot, issue and receive royal commands, and with your brothers hold command and provincial posts, your network displayed across the capital region.

units.zh: 自秦、漢以來，隆赫之極，豈有若此者乎！
units.en: Since Qin and Han, has splendor reached such a height!

units.zh: 以吾觀之，若功就事舉，必享申伯之名；
units.en: In my view, if your work succeeds you will enjoy Shen Bo's fame;

units.zh: 如或不立，將不免梁竇之跡矣。
units.en: if not, you will not escape the fate of Liang Ji and Dou Xian.

units.zh: 每睹史傳，未嘗不寵恣母族，使執權亂朝，先有殊世之榮，尋有負乘之累，所謂愛之適足以為害。
units.en: Reading the histories, I see maternal relatives indulged and allowed to wield power and disorder the court: first they enjoy extraordinary glory, then suffer the consequences of holding positions beyond their station. This is what is meant by love proving sufficient to cause harm.

units.zh: 吾常忿歷代之主，不盡防萌終寵之術，何不業以一土之封，令籓國相承，如周之齊、陳？
units.en: I have often resented that successive rulers did not fully master the means of preventing incipient trouble while preserving favor to the end. Why not establish these relatives with a territorial fief and let their descendants inherit the vassal state, as with Qi and Chen under Zhou?

units.zh: 如此則永保南面之尊，復何黜辱之憂乎！
units.en: Then they would forever preserve honor facing south, with no fear of dismissal or disgrace!

units.zh: 竇武、何進好善虛己。
units.en: Dou Wu and He Jin loved goodness and humbled themselves.

units.zh: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
units.en: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.

value.event: Competing source readings are retained; no single historical year is selected. Haedong Yoksa, a later Joseon compilation explicitly citing Jinshu, files this campaign under Xiankang 3 (337) and notes that Tongjian has year 5. It is evidence for a later chronological arrangement, not independent contemporary testimony. Tongjian explicitly places the campaign and Zhao's request for a covenant under Xiankang 5 (339). Samguk Sagi assigns the campaign to Gogugwon year 9, giving 339 on the accession-in-331 synchronization stated in Haedong's note, which itself relies on the Korean history. The campaign wording closely parallels Tongjian and Jinshu; this alone does not establish direct borrowing or independent corroboration, so these accounts are not counted as multiple independent confirmations. Jinshu's unresolved 其年 follows a narrative insertion concerning Yu Liang's death and the memorial/letter leading to recognition of Huang. Taking the death notice as the narrative year's anchor gives a possible 340 alignment; taking the recognition episode as its anchor gives a possible 341 alignment, since Tongjian dates the formal grant to 341. These are distinct antecedent/alignment hypotheses, not a claim that a campaign after the 341 grant could occur in 340. The 337-341 interval is the inclusive envelope of these reported or conditional readings, not continuous campaigning or support for every intervening year. Literal 其年 remains unexpanded.

Competing source readings are retained; no single historical year is selected. Jinshu dates the heir's homage only 明年, the year following the disputed campaign. Haedong Yoksa, a later Joseon compilation explicitly citing Jinshu rather than independent contemporary testimony, places the campaign in Xiankang 3 (337) and appends 明年, implying homage in 338. Samguk Sagi explicitly records the heir's homage in Gogugwon year 10, giving 340 on the accession-in-331 synchronization stated in Haedong's note, which relies on the Korean history. Tongjian volume 96 explicitly dates the campaign to 339 but does not explicitly record this heir's homage in its 340 section. Thus 340 is both Samguk's express regnal-year placement and a next-year inference from Tongjian's campaign date combined with Jinshu's relative sequence; it is not an express Tongjian homage entry. Shared campaign wording among the histories does not establish direct textual dependence or independence of the separate homage notice, so no independent corroboration is claimed. If Jinshu's campaign 其年 is instead aligned with the death notice in 340, 明年 gives 341; if aligned with the recognition episode dated 341 in Tongjian, it gives 342. These are separate narrative-alignment hypotheses, not a campaign in 340 after a formal grant in 341. The 338-342 interval is an inclusive envelope of alternative readings, not a continuous homage event or express support for every intervening year. Literal 明年 and its one-year relationship to the campaign are retained.

units.en: Worthy men rallied to them; although eunuchs brought them into peril, the realm lamented them because they could nonetheless conduct themselves without arrogance and gave their lives for the state.

units.zh: 方今四海有倒懸之急，中夏逋僭逆之寇，家有漉血之怨，人有復仇之憾，甯得安枕逍遙，雅談卒歲邪！
units.en: Now the realm hangs inverted, rebels roam China, families bear blood-soaked grievances and men thirst for vengeance; how can one rest at ease and talk elegantly through the year!

units.zh: 吾雖寡德，過蒙先帝列將之授，以數郡之人，尚欲併吞強虜，是以自頃迄今，交鋒接刃，一時務農，三時用武，而猶師徒不頓，倉有餘粟，敵人日畏，我境日廣，況乃王者之威，堂堂之勢，豈可同年而語哉！
units.en: Though deficient in virtue, I undeservedly received appointment as one of the former emperor’s generals. With the people of only several commanderies, I still aspire to engulf powerful enemies. Thus, from recent times until now we have crossed weapons in battle, farming for one season and fighting for three; yet our troops are not exhausted, our granaries have surplus grain, our enemies fear us more each day, and our territory grows daily. How much greater, then, are imperial majesty and its imposing power—how could the two be compared!

units.en: Huang sent the trader Wang Che to spy; Murong Han met him in silence, only clutching his chest.

units.zh: 車還以白，皝曰：「翰欲來也。」
units.en: Wang Che reported the sign; Huang said, “He wants to come home.”

units.zh: 乃遣車遺翰弓矢，翰乃竊歸駿馬，攜其二子而還。
units.en: He sent Wang Che with a bow and arrows; Murong Han stole horses and rode back with his two sons.

units.zh: 皝將圖石氏，從容謂諸將曰：「石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重，城之南北必不設備，今若詭路出其不意，冀之北土盡可破也。」
units.en: Huang was about to plan against the Shi clan; he calmly told the generals: “Shi Hu thinks the cities of Anle and the rest are strictly and heavily guarded, and surely sets no defenses north and south of the city; now if we take a deceitful route and strike where he does not expect, the whole northern territory of Ji can be broken.”

units.zh: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
units.en: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.

units.zh: 使陽裕、唐柱等築龍城，構宮廟，改柳城為龍城縣。
units.en: He had Yang Yu and Tang Zhu build Longcheng, raised palaces and shrines, and renamed Liucheng county Longcheng.

units.zh: 於是成帝使兼大鴻臚郭希持節拜皝侍中、大都督河北諸軍事、大將軍、燕王，其餘官皆如故。
units.en: Emperor Cheng then sent concurrent Grand Herald Guo Xi bearing credentials to appoint Huang Palace Attendant, Grand Commander of all military affairs north of the Yellow River, Grand General, and King of Yan, leaving the rest of his offices as before.

units.zh: 封諸功臣百餘人，
units.en: He enfeoffed more than a hundred deserving officers.

units.zh: 咸康七年，皝遷都龍城。
units.en: In the seventh year of Xiankang, he moved his capital to Longcheng.

units.zh: 率勁卒四萬，入自南陝，以伐宇文、高句麗，又使翰及子垂為前鋒，遣長史王寓等勒眾萬五千，從北置而進。
units.en: He took forty thousand picked soldiers through the southern defile against Yuwen and Goguryeo, with Murong Han and his son Murong Chui as vanguard, and sent chief clerk Wang Yu and others leading fifteen thousand to advance from Beizhi.

units.zh: 高句麗王釗謂皝軍之從北路也，乃遣其弟武統精銳五萬距北置，躬率弱卒以防南陝。
units.en: King Gao Zhao assumed Huang’s army was coming by the northern route, so he sent his younger brother Wu leading fifty thousand picked troops to block Beizhi, and personally led weaker troops to guard the southern defile.

units.zh: 翰與釗戰於木底，大敗之，乘勝遂入丸都，釗單馬而遁。
units.en: Murong Han routed him at Mudi, pressed into Wandu, and Zhao fled alone on horseback.

units.zh: 皝掘釗父利墓，載其屍並其母妻珍寶，掠男女五萬餘口，焚其宮室，毀丸都而歸。
units.en: Huang opened Gao Zhao’s father Li’s tomb, carried off the corpse together with Zhao’s mother, wife, and treasures, plundered more than fifty thousand men and women, fired the palaces, razed Wandu, and returned.

units.zh: 明年，釗遣使稱臣于皝，貢其方物，乃歸其父屍。
units.en: The next year Gao Zhao sent envoys declaring himself a subject of Huang, offered local products, and Huang then returned his father’s corpse.

units.zh: 宇文歸遣其國相莫淺渾伐皝，諸將請戰，皝不許。
units.en: Yuwen Gui sent his state chancellor Moqian Hun against Huang; Huang’s generals begged to fight but he refused.

units.zh: 皝躬巡郡縣，勸課農桑，起龍城宮闕。
units.en: Murong Huang personally toured his prefectures and counties, urged farming and sericulture, and raised palaces at Longcheng.

units.zh: 尋又率騎二萬親伐宇文歸，以翰及垂為前鋒。
units.en: He soon took twenty thousand horse against Yuwen Gui, with Murong Han and Murong Chui as van.

units.zh: 於是前戰，斬奕於，盡俘其眾，歸遠遁漠北。
units.en: He then advanced to battle, beheaded Sheyiyu, and wholly captured their host; Gui fled far to the northern desert.

units.zh: 皝開地千餘里，徙其部人五萬餘落于昌黎，改涉奕於城為威德城。
units.en: He opened over a thousand li of territory, moved more than fifty thousand of their tribal settlements to Changli, and changed Sheyiyu city to Weide city.

units.zh: 行飲至之禮，論功行賞各有差。
units.en: He held a victory feast and handed out graded rewards.

units.zh: 以牧牛給貧家，田于苑中，公收其八，二分入私。
units.en: Herding oxen were given to poor families to till fields in the royal park; the state took eight-tenths, and two-tenths went to the private holders.

units.zh: 有牛而無地者，亦田苑中，公收其七，三分入私。
units.en: Those who had oxen but no land also tilled the park; the state took seven-tenths, and three-tenths went to the private holders.

units.zh: 皝記室參軍封裕諫曰：臣聞聖王之宰國也，薄賦而藏于百姓，分之以三等之田，十一而稅之；
units.en: Murong Huang's secretary Feng Yu remonstrated: I have heard that a sage king keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;

units.zh: 主者奏以妖言犯上，至之于法，殿下慈弘苞納，恕其大辟，猶削黜禁錮，不齒於朝。
units.en: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.

units.en: King Gao Zhao assumed Huang’s army was coming by the northern route, so he sent his younger brother Wu leading fifty thousand picked troops to block Beizhi, and personally led weaker troops to guard the southern defile.

units.zh: 翰與釗戰於木底，大敗之，乘勝遂入丸都，釗單馬而遁。
units.en: Murong Han routed him at Mudi, pressed into Wandu, and Zhao fled alone on horseback.

units.zh: 皝掘釗父利墓，載其屍並其母妻珍寶，掠男女五萬餘口，焚其宮室，毀丸都而歸。
units.en: Huang opened Gao Zhao’s father Li’s tomb, carried off the corpse together with Zhao’s mother, wife, and treasures, plundered more than fifty thousand men and women, fired the palaces, razed Wandu, and returned.

units.zh: 明年，釗遣使稱臣于皝，貢其方物，乃歸其父屍。
units.en: The next year Gao Zhao sent envoys declaring himself a subject of Huang, offered local products, and Huang then returned his father’s corpse.

units.zh: 宇文歸遣其國相莫淺渾伐皝，諸將請戰，皝不許。
units.en: Yuwen Gui sent his state chancellor Moqian Hun against Huang; Huang’s generals begged to fight but he refused.

units.zh: 渾以皝為憚之，荒酒縱獵，不復設備。
units.en: Moqian Hun assumed Huang was afraid and gave himself to drink and hunting without precautions.

units.zh: 皝曰：「渾奢忌已甚，今則可一戰矣。」
units.en: Huang said, “Moqian Hun’s extravagance and jealousy are already extreme; now then we can fight.”

units.zh: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
units.en: He sent Murong Han with cavalry to strike them; Moqian Hun was badly defeated and escaped alone, while his entire host was taken captive.

units.zh: 皝躬巡郡縣，勸課農桑，起龍城宮闕。
units.en: Murong Huang personally toured his prefectures and counties, urged farming and sericulture, and raised palaces at Longcheng.

units.zh: 尋又率騎二萬親伐宇文歸，以翰及垂為前鋒。
units.en: He soon took twenty thousand horse against Yuwen Gui, with Murong Han and Murong Chui as van.

units.zh: 歸使其騎將涉奕於盡眾距翰，皝馳遣謂翰曰：「奕於雄悍，宜小避之，待虜勢驕，然後取也。」
units.en: Yuwen Gui sent his cavalry general Sheyiyu to hold Murong Han with the whole host; Huang sent word at a gallop: “Sheyiyu is fierce and bold; you ought to avoid him a little, wait until the bandits grow arrogant, then take them.”

units.zh: 翰曰：「歸之精銳，盡在於此，今若克之，則歸可不勞兵而滅。
units.en: Murong Han replied, “Yuwen Gui’s best troops are here; crush them and his realm falls without a long campaign.

units.zh: 奕于徒有虛名，其實易與耳，不宜縱敵挫吾兵氣。」
units.en: Sheyiyu vainly has an empty name; in truth he is easy to deal with; we ought not to loose the enemy and blunt our army’s spirit.”

units.zh: 於是前戰，斬奕於，盡俘其眾，歸遠遁漠北。
units.en: He then advanced to battle, beheaded Sheyiyu, and wholly captured their host; Gui fled far to the northern desert.

units.zh: 皝開地千餘里，徙其部人五萬餘落于昌黎，改涉奕於城為威德城。
units.en: He opened over a thousand li of territory, moved more than fifty thousand of their tribal settlements to Changli, and changed Sheyiyu city to Weide city.

units.zh: 行飲至之禮，論功行賞各有差。
units.en: He held a victory feast and handed out graded rewards.

units.zh: 以牧牛給貧家，田于苑中，公收其八，二分入私。
units.en: Herding oxen were given to poor families to till fields in the royal park; the state took eight-tenths, and two-tenths went to the private holders.

units.zh: 有牛而無地者，亦田苑中，公收其七，三分入私。
units.en: Those who had oxen but no land also tilled the park; the state took seven-tenths, and three-tenths went to the private holders.

units.zh: 皝記室參軍封裕諫曰：臣聞聖王之宰國也，薄賦而藏于百姓，分之以三等之田，十一而稅之；
units.en: Murong Huang's secretary Feng Yu remonstrated: I have heard that a sage king keeps taxes light and stores wealth among the people, divides land into three grades, and levies one part in ten;

units.zh: 寒者衣之，饑者食之，使家給人足。
units.en: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.

units.zh: 寒者衣之，饑者食之，使家給人足。
units.en: he clothes the cold and feeds the hungry so that every household is provided for and every person has enough.

units.zh: 雖水旱而不為災者，何也？
units.en: Why then are flood and drought not disaster?

units.zh: 高選農官，務盡勸課，人治周田百畝，亦不假牛力；
units.en: Agricultural officers are carefully selected and encouragement and assessment are pressed to the utmost, so each man tends a full hundred mu without relying on ox power;

units.zh: 力田者受旌顯之賞，惰農者有不齒之罰。
units.en: those who labor in the fields receive honors of distinction, while idle farmers suffer the penalty of being denied peer standing.

units.zh: 又量事置官，量官置人，使官必稱須，人不虛位，度歲入多少，裁而祿之。
units.en: Again, assess the work to establish offices and the offices to appoint personnel, ensuring that offices meet needs and no one occupies a post in vain; estimate the annual revenue and set their salaries accordingly.

units.zh: 供百僚之外，藏之太倉，三年之耕，餘一年之粟。
units.en: Beyond supplying officials, grain is stored in the Great Granary until three years' plowing leaves one year's surplus.

units.zh: 以斯而積，公用于何不足？
units.en: Stored thus, how could public use fail?

units.zh: 水旱其如百姓何！
units.en: Flood and drought, what can they do to the people!

units.zh: 雖務農之令屢發，二千石令長莫有志勤在公、銳盡地利者。
units.en: Yet though farming orders issue repeatedly, no two-thousand-bushel official or magistrate is intent on public diligence or keen to exhaust the land's advantage.

units.zh: 故漢祖知其如此，以墾田不實，征殺二千石以十數，是以明、章之際，號次升平。
units.en: Knowing this, Han's founder summoned and executed two-thousand-bushel officials by the tens for false reports of reclaimed fields, and under Ming and Zhang the age was called nearly peaceful.

units.zh: 自永嘉喪亂，百姓流亡，中原蕭條，千里無煙，饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑。
units.en: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; people wander and perish from hunger and cold, falling one after another into the ditches.

units.zh: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
units.en: Murong Hui, by divine martial prowess and sagacious strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign peoples beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children returning to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; people were numerous, land was scarce, and four in ten had no fields.

units.zh: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
units.en: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.

units.zh: 宜省罷諸苑，以業流人。
units.en: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and settle the displaced on them.

units.zh: 人至而無資產者，賜之以牧牛。
units.en: Grant cattle to those who arrive without property.

units.zh: 人既殿下之人，牛豈失乎！
units.en: If the people are yours, how could the cattle be lost!

units.zh: 善藏者藏于百姓，若斯而已矣。
units.en: True storage is storage among the people; that is all.

units.zh: 邇者深副樂土之望，中國之人皆將壺餐奉迎，石季龍誰與居乎！
units.en: Recently you have deeply fulfilled the hope of a happy land; the people of China will all bring food to welcome you. Who then will remain with Shi Hu?

units.zh: 且魏、晉雖道消之世，猶削百姓不至於七八，持官牛田者官得六分，百姓得四分，私牛而官田者與官中分，百姓安之，人皆悅樂。
units.en: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, still did not cut the people by as much as seven or eight tenths; those farming with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people, those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state, and the people were secure and all rejoiced.

units.zh: 臣猶曰非明王之道，而況增乎！
units.en: I still say this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if burdens increase!

units.zh: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
units.en: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation after the Zheng and Bai canals and the methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; drought is eased by opening channels to supply water like rain, and floodwaters are directed into drainage channels, so that above there is no anxiety like that expressed in Yunhan and below there is no misery from inundation.

units.zh: 句麗、百濟及宇文、段部之人，皆兵勢所徙，非如中國慕義而至，咸有思歸之心。
units.en: Goguryeo, Baekje, Yuwen, and Duan peoples were moved by force, not like Chinese who came admiring righteousness; all long to return home.

units.zh: 今戶垂十萬，狹湊都城，恐方將為國家深害，宜分其兄弟宗屬，徙于西境諸城，撫之以恩，檢之以法，使不得散在居人，知國之虛實。
units.en: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state. Divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and restrain them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.

units.zh: 今中原未平，資畜宜廣，官司猥多，遊食不少，一夫不耕，歲受其饑。
units.en: The central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; when one man does not plow, hunger is suffered through the year.

units.zh: 必取於耕者而食之，一人食一人之力，游食數萬，損亦如之，安可以家給人足，治致升平！
units.en: Food must be taken from those who plow to feed them; one person consumes the labor of one person, and with tens of thousands living without working, the loss is likewise in the tens of thousands; how can every household be provided for and every person have enough, and government bring about peace!

units.zh: 殿下降覽古今之事多矣，政之巨患莫甚於斯。
units.en: Your Highness has read past and present; no governmental evil exceeds this.

units.zh: 其有經略出世，才稱時求者，自可隨須置之列位。
units.en: Those with world-surpassing strategy and talent matching the age's needs may be placed in posts as required.

units.zh: 非此已往，其耕而食，蠶而衣，亦天之道也。
units.en: Beyond this, plow to eat and raise silkworms to clothe, as heaven ordains.

units.zh: 殿下聖性寬明，思言若渴，故人盡芻蕘，有犯無隱。
units.en: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for counsel as for water; therefore men fully offer even rustic woodcutter counsel, offending yet not hiding.

units.zh: 前者參軍王憲、大夫劉明並竭忠獻款，以貢至言，雖頗有逆鱗，意在無責。
units.en: Staff officer Wang Xian and Grand Master Liu Ming spoke with full loyalty; though they ruffled scales, they meant no offense.

units.zh: 主者奏以妖言犯上，至之于法，殿下慈弘苞納，恕其大辟，猶削黜禁錮，不齒於朝。
units.en: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.

units.zh: 其言是也，殿下固宜納之；
units.en: If their words were right, you ought to accept them;

units.zh: 如其非也，宜亮其狂狷。
units.en: if not, make allowance for blunt integrity.

units.zh: 罪諫臣而求直言，亦猶北行詣越，豈有得邪！
units.en: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be any gain!

units.zh: 右長史宋該等阿媚苟容，輕劾諫士，己無骨鯁，嫉人有之，掩蔽耳目，不忠之甚。
units.en: Right chief clerk Song Gai and others flatter, impeach remonstrators lightly, have no backbone yet envy it in others, and cover eyes and ears, most disloyal.

units.zh: 四業者國之所資，教學者有國盛事。
units.en: The four occupations sustain the state; teaching and learning are its great affair.

units.zh: 習戰務農，尤其本也。
units.en: War training and agriculture are especially the root.

units.zh: 百工商賈，猶其末耳。
units.en: Merchants and craftsmen are the branch.

units.en: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be any gain!

units.zh: 右長史宋該等阿媚苟容，輕劾諫士，己無骨鯁，嫉人有之，掩蔽耳目，不忠之甚。
units.en: Right chief clerk Song Gai and others flatter, impeach remonstrators lightly, have no backbone yet envy it in others, and cover eyes and ears, most disloyal.

units.zh: 四業者國之所資，教學者有國盛事。
units.en: The four occupations sustain the state; teaching and learning are its great affair.

units.zh: 習戰務農，尤其本也。
units.en: War training and agriculture are especially the root.

units.zh: 百工商賈，猶其末耳。
units.en: Merchants and craftsmen are the branch.

units.zh: 宜量軍國所須，置其員數，已外歸之于農，教之戰法，學者三年無成，亦宜還之于農，不可徒充大員，以塞聰俊之路。
units.en: It is fitting to measure what army and state require, set the number of posts, and return the rest to farming; teach them battle methods; students who after three years have no achievement should also return to farming; they must not vainly fill the authorized establishment and block the path of the keen and worthy.

units.zh: 臣之所言當也，願時速施行；
units.en: If I am right, enact this swiftly;

units.zh: 非也，登加罪戮，使天下知朝廷從善如流，罰惡不淹。
units.en: if not, punish and execute me at once, so the realm knows the court follows good like flowing water and punishes evil without delay.

units.zh: 王憲、劉明，忠臣也，願宥忤鱗之愆，收其藥石之效。
units.en: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; pardon their bluntness and gather the benefit of their medicine-stone counsel.

units.zh: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
units.en: Huang then issued an order, saying: “On reading the remonstrance of Recorder Feng, I am truly afraid.

units.zh: 君以黎元為國，黎元以穀為命。
units.en: The ruler takes the people as the foundation of the state; the people depend on grain for their lives.

units.zh: 然則農者，國之本也，而二千石令長不遵孟春之令，惰農弗勸，宜以尤不修辟者措之刑法，肅厲屬城。
units.en: Agriculture is then the root of the state, yet two-thousand-bushel officials and county magistrates do not obey the first-month orders and do not urge lazy farmers; those especially who fail to open wasteland should be put under criminal law to awe and discipline the dependent cities.

units.zh: 主者明詳推檢，具狀以聞。
units.en: Let bureaus audit every case and report in full.

units.zh: 苑囿悉可罷之，以給百姓無田業者。
units.en: Close the hunting reserves and give that land to landless peasants.

units.zh: 貧者全無資產，不能自存，各賜牧牛一頭。
units.en: The poor who wholly lack assets and cannot support themselves shall each be granted one ox.

units.zh: 若私有餘力，樂取官牛墾官田者，其依魏、晉舊法。
units.en: If any have surplus private labor and gladly take official oxen to reclaim official fields, let them follow the old Wei and Jin rules.

units.zh: 溝洫溉灌，有益官私，主者量造，務盡水陸之勢。
units.en: Irrigation ditches and channels benefit public and private interests; let the responsible officials plan and build them, striving to exhaust the advantages of water and land.

units.zh: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
units.en: The heartland is not yet pacified, warfare does not cease, and many have rendered meritorious and loyal service, so the official establishment cannot be reduced.

units.zh: 待克平凶醜，徐更議之。
units.en: We will revisit staff cuts after victory.

units.zh: 百工商賈數，四佐與列將速定大員，余者還農。
units.en: The Four Assistants and the generals shall promptly fix quotas for artisans and merchants; the rest shall return to farming.

units.zh: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
units.en: Students unable to benefit from instruction shall also be removed from the rolls.

units.zh: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
units.en: For a minister to offer words that touch his ruler is most difficult; wild and baseless matters should all be brushed aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.

units.zh: 王憲、劉明雖其罪應禁黜，亦猶孤之無大量也。
units.en: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, although their offenses would warrant ban and dismissal, also show my own lack of forbearance.

units.zh: 可悉復本官，仍居諫司。
units.en: They may all be restored to their original offices and still serve in the remonstrance bureau.

units.zh: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
units.en: Master Feng is steadfastly upright and deeply embodies the character of a royal minister.

units.zh: 《詩》不云乎：'無言不酬。
units.en: As the Odes says, “No word goes unanswered.”

units.zh: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
units.en: So award him fifty thousand cash, and clearly announce inside and outside that whoever wishes to state my faults, whether noble or base, need have no taboo.”

units.zh: 時有黑龍、白龍各一，見於龍山，皝親率群僚觀之，去龍二百餘步，祭乙太宰。
units.en: At that time one black dragon and one white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang personally led his officials to observe them from more than two hundred paces away and offered a sacrifice (the ritual wording in the source remains textually uncertain; no emendation is assumed).

units.zh: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去。
units.en: The two dragons crossed their heads, sported and soared, shed their horns, and departed.

units.zh: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
units.en: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and built the Longxiang Buddhist monastery on the mountain.

units.zh: 賜其大臣子弟為官學生者號高門生，立東庠于舊宮，以行鄉射之禮，每月臨觀，考試優劣。
units.en: He gave the sons and younger brothers of his senior ministers who were official students the title “high-gate students,” established the eastern school in the old palace for the village archery rites, and personally observed and assessed their performance each month.

units.zh: 皝雅好文籍，勤于講授，學徒甚盛，至千餘人。
units.en: He loved books, lectured tirelessly, and kept more than a thousand students.

units.zh: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
units.en: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions to teach the sons of the nobility.

units.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
units.en: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.

units.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
units.en: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.

units.zh: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
units.en: Huang personally went to the eastern school to examine students; those whose command of the classics was thorough and outstanding were promoted to fill posts as close attendants.

units.zh: 以久旱，丐百姓田租。
units.en: Because of the prolonged drought, he remitted the common people's field rent.

units.zh: 罷成周、冀陽、營丘等郡。
units.en: He abolished Chengzhou, Jiyang, Yingqiu, and other commanderies.

units.zh: 以勃海人為興集縣，河間人為寧集縣，廣平、魏郡人為興平縣，東萊、北海人為育黎縣，吳人為吳縣，悉隸燕國。
units.en: He made the Bohai people into Xingji County, the Hejian people into Ningji County, the Guangping and Wei commandery people into Xingping County, the Donglai and Beihai people into Yuli County, and the Wu people into Wu County, all subordinate to the state of Yan.

units.zh: 皝嘗畋於西鄙，將濟河，見一父老，服硃衣，乘白馬，舉手麾皝曰：「此非獵所，王其還也。」
units.en: While hunting on the western frontier Murong Huang was about to cross a river when he saw an old man in cinnabar robes on a white horse, who waved him off and said, "This is not a place for hunting; Your Majesty should return."

units.zh: 秘之不言，遂濟河，連日大獲。
units.en: He kept silent, crossed the river, and enjoyed great sport for days.

units.zh: 後見白兔，馳射之，馬倒被傷，乃說所見。
units.en: Later he saw a white hare, galloped to shoot it; his horse fell and he was injured, then he told what he had seen.

units.zh: 輦而還宮，引俊屬以後事。
units.en: He was carried back to the palace in a litter and summoned Jun to entrust him with affairs after his death.

units.zh: 以永和四年死，在位十五年，時年五十二。
units.en: He died in the fourth year of Yonghe after fifteen years on the throne, aged fifty-two.

units.zh: 俊僭號，追諡文明皇帝。
units.en: When Murong Jun assumed the imperial title in usurpation, he posthumously honored his father as Emperor Wenming.

units.zh: 慕容翰
units.en: Murong Han.

units.zh: 慕容翰，字元邕，廆之庶長子也。
units.en: Murong Han, courtesy name Yuanyong, was Murong Hui’s eldest son by a concubine.

units.zh: 性雄豪，多權略，猿臂工射，膂力過人。
units.en: He was heroic and bold, full of stratagems, ape-armed and skilled at archery, with strength that surpassed others.

units.zh: 廆甚奇之，委以折沖之任。
units.en: Murong Hui prized him and gave him the hardest fighting assignments.

units.zh: 行師征伐，所在有功，威聲大振，為遠近所憚。
units.en: Every campaign brought success; neighbors far and near feared him.

units.zh: 作鎮遼東，高句麗不敢為寇。
units.en: While he held Liaodong, Goguryeo dared not raid.

units.zh: 善撫接，愛儒學，自士大夫至於卒伍，莫不樂而從之。
units.en: He won men from gentry to ranks by kindness and a love of learning.

units.zh: 及奔段遼，深為遼所敬愛。
units.en: When he fled to Duan Liao, he was deeply respected and loved by Liao.

units.zh: 柳城之敗，段蘭欲乘勝深入，翰慮成本國之害，詭說于蘭，蘭遂不進。
units.en: After the defeat at Liucheng, Duan Lan wanted to ride the victory and push deep; Murong Han, fearing this would bring harm on his native state, gave Lan deceitful counsel, and Lan then did not advance.

units.zh: 後石季龍征遼，皝親將三軍略令支以北，遼議欲追之，翰知皝躬自總戎，戰必克勝，乃謂遼曰：「今石氏向至，方對大故，不宜復以小小為事。
units.en: Later when Shi Hu campaigned against Duan Liao and Murong Huang personally led an army to raid north of Lingzhi, Duan Liao debated pursuit. Knowing Huang commanded in person and must win, Murong Han told Duan Liao, "Now the Shi are about to arrive and you face a great enemy; you should not again take up small matters.

units.zh: 燕王自來，士馬精銳。
units.en: The King of Yan has come in person; his soldiers and horses are elite.

units.zh: 兵者凶器，戰有危慮，若其失利，何以南禦乎！」
units.en: Weapons are ill-omened tools, and battle holds peril; if you lose here, how will you defend the south?”

units.zh: 蘭怒曰：「吾前聽卿誑說，致成今患，不復入卿計中矣。」
units.en: Duan Lan snapped, “Your last ‘advice’ ruined me—I will not heed you again.”

units.zh: 乃率眾追皝，蘭果大敗。
units.en: He then led his forces to pursue Huang, and Lan was indeed crushingly defeated.

units.zh: 翰雖處仇國，因事立忠，皆此類也。
units.en: Although Murong Han dwelt in an enemy state, he established loyalty through the course of events—all cases were of this kind.

units.zh: 及遼奔走，翰又北投宇文歸。
units.en: When Duan Liao fled in defeat, Han again went north to Yuwen Gui.

units.zh: 既而逃，歸乃遣勁騎百餘追之。
units.en: Han then fled, and Gui sent over a hundred picked cavalry to pursue him.

units.zh: 翰遙謂追者曰：「吾既思戀而歸，理無反面。
units.en: He shouted to them, “I mean to go home—I will not turn back.

units.zh: 吾之弓矢，汝曹足知，無為相逼，自取死也。
units.en: You know my bow and arrows well enough—do not press me and bring death on yourselves.

units.zh: 吾處汝國久，恨不殺汝。
units.en: I have lived among you too long—I should have killed you.

units.zh: 汝可百步豎刀，吾射中者，汝便宜反；
units.en: Plant a blade at a hundred paces—if I hit it, withdraw;

units.zh: 不中者，可來前也。」
units.en: if I miss, come on.”

units.zh: 歸騎解刀豎之，翰一發便中刀鐶，追騎乃散。
units.en: They fixed a blade; his first arrow struck the ring and they broke off the chase.

units.zh: 既至，皝甚加恩禮，
units.en: Huang welcomed him with rich honors.

units.zh: 建元二年，從皝討宇文歸，臨陣為流矢所中，臥病積時。
units.en: In the second year of Jianyuan, he joined the war on Yuwen Gui, took a stray shaft, and lay long ill.

units.zh: 後疾漸愈，於其家中騎馬自試，或有人告翰私習騎，疑為非常。
units.en: Later, as his illness gradually improved, he tried riding at home to test himself; someone reported that Han was privately practising riding and suspected something extraordinary.

units.zh: 皝素忌之，遂賜死焉。
units.en: Huang, who had long been jealous of him, thereupon granted him death.

units.zh: 翰臨死謂使者曰：「翰懷疑外奔，罪不容誅，不能以骸骨委賊庭，故歸罪有司。
units.en: Nearing death Murong Han told the envoy, “Han harbored distrust and fled abroad; my crime is too great for death to atone; I could not leave my bones in a rebel court, so I returned to submit to the authorities.

units.zh: 天慈曲湣，不肆之市朝，今日之死，翰之生也。
units.en: The king spared me a public execution—this death is mercy.

units.zh: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
units.en: But the rebel Hu barbarians straddle and hold the Divine Land, and the Central Plain is not yet pacified. I always steeled my heart and swore that I would swallow up the vile caitiffs, above to fulfil the late king's dying wish and below to discharge my duty to the realm between the mountains and the sea.

units.zh: 不圖此心不遂，沒有餘恨，命也奈何！」
units.en: That hope dies with me—such is fate.”

units.zh: 仰藥而死。
units.en: He drank the poison and died.

units.zh: 陽裕
units.en: Yang Yu.

units.zh: 陽裕，字士倫，右北平無終人也。
units.en: Yang Yu, courtesy name Shilun, came from Wuzhong in right Beiping.

units.zh: 少孤，兄弟皆早亡，單煢獨立，雖宗族無能識者，惟叔父耽幼而奇之，曰：「此兒非惟吾門之標秀，乃佐時之良器也。」
units.en: Orphaned young, with brothers dead early, he stood alone; few in the clan knew him, but his uncle Dan marveled at him even in youth and said, "This child is not only our clan's outstanding ornament but an instrument to serve the age."

units.zh: 刺史和演辟為主簿。
units.en: Governor He Yan made him chief clerk.

units.zh: 段遼與皝相攻，裕諫曰：「臣聞親仁善鄰，國之寶也。
units.en: When Duan Liao and Murong Huang clashed, Yang Yu urged, “A state’s greatest treasure is to cherish kindness and befriend one’s neighbors.

units.zh: 皝素聞裕名，即命釋其囚，拜郎中令，遷大將軍左司馬。
units.en: Murong Huang, who had long heard of Yu’s name, at once ordered his bonds released, appointed him Palace Director, then promoted him to Grand General’s Left Major.

units.zh: 東破高句麗，北滅宇文歸，皆豫其謀，皝甚器重之。
units.en: He helped plan the eastern victory over Goguryeo and the northern destruction of Yuwen Gui, and Huang came to rely on him heavily.

units.zh: 及遷都和龍，裕雅有巧思，皝所制城池宮闔，皆裕之規模。
units.en: When the capital shifted to Helong, Yang Yu’s engineering shaped every wall and tower Murong Huang built.

units.zh: 及死，皝甚悼之，時年六十二。
units.en: When he died at sixty-two, Murong Huang mourned him deeply.

units.en: When Duan Liao fled in defeat, Han again went north to Yuwen Gui.

units.en: That hope dies with me—such is fate.”

units.en: He drank the poison and died.

units.zh: 陽裕
units.en: Yang Yu.

units.zh: 陽裕，字士倫，右北平無終人也。
units.en: Yang Yu, courtesy name Shilun, came from Wuzhong in right Beiping.

units.zh: 少孤，兄弟皆早亡，單煢獨立，雖宗族無能識者，惟叔父耽幼而奇之，曰：「此兒非惟吾門之標秀，乃佐時之良器也。」
units.en: Orphaned young, with brothers dead early, he stood alone; few in the clan knew him, but his uncle Dan marveled at him even in youth and said, "This child is not only our clan's outstanding ornament but an instrument to serve the age."

units.zh: 刺史和演辟為主簿。
units.en: Governor He Yan made him chief clerk.

units.zh: 王浚領州，轉治中從事，忌而不能任。
units.en: When Wang Jun held the province, Yu was transferred to administration aide; Jun was jealous and would not employ him.

units.zh: 石勒既克薊城，問棗嵩曰：「幽州人士，誰最可者？」
units.en: After Shi Le took Jicheng he asked Zao Song, "Among the gentlemen of Youzhou, who is most worthy?"

units.zh: 嵩曰：「燕國劉翰，德素長者。
units.en: Zao Song said, "Liu Han of Yan, whose virtue is that of a plain elder.

units.zh: 北平陽裕，幹事之才。」
units.en: Yang Yu of Beiping for administrative talent.”

units.zh: 勒曰：「若如君言，王公何以不任？」
units.en: Shi Le asked, "If what you say is so, why did Duke Wang not employ them?"

units.zh: 嵩曰：「王公由不能任，所以為明公擒也。」
units.en: Song answered, “Because he could not use them, you captured him.”

units.zh: 勒方任之，裕乃微服潛遁。
units.en: Shi Le meant to employ Yang Yu, who fled in disguise.

units.zh: 時鮮卑單于段眷為晉驃騎大將軍、遼西公，雅好人物，虛心延裕。
units.en: At that time the Xianbei shanyu Duan Juan, who held the Jin titles of General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi, had a refined fondness for men of talent and humbly invited Yang Yu.

units.zh: 裕謂友人成泮曰：「仲尼喜佛肸之召，以匏瓜自喻，伊尹亦稱何事非君，何使非民，聖賢尚如此，況吾曹乎！
units.en: Yang Yu told his friend Cheng Pan, "Confucius rejoiced at Bi Xi's summons and likened himself to a gourd; Yi Yin too said, 'What affair is not that of the lord? What people are not his subjects?' Even sages were thus, how much more we!

units.zh: 眷今召我，豈徒然哉！」
units.en: Duan Juan’s summons is no empty gesture!”

units.zh: 泮曰：「今華夏分崩，九州幅裂，軌跡所及，易水而已。
units.en: Cheng Pan replied, “Now Huaxia is split and crumbling, the nine provinces torn apart; where proper tracks reach is only as far as the Yi River.

units.zh: 欲偃蹇考槃，以待大通者，俟河之清也。
units.en: To wish to live in proud reclusion and wait for a great opening is to wait for the Yellow River to run clear.

units.zh: 人壽幾何？
units.en: How long is a life?

units.zh: 古人以為白駒之歎。
units.en: The ancients sighed at time’s white colt.

units.zh: 少遊有雲，郡掾足以廕後，況國相乎！
units.en: Shaoyou said that a post as commandery clerk was enough to shelter one's descendants; how much more the post of chancellor of a state!

units.zh: 卿追蹤伊、孔，抑亦知機其神也。」
units.en: You follow Confucius and Yi Yin—you know when Heaven calls.”

units.zh: 裕乃應之。
units.en: Yang Yu accepted Duan Juan’s offer.

units.zh: 拜郎中令、中軍將軍，處上卿位。
units.en: He was named palace director and central army general, ranking among the highest ministers.

units.zh: 曆事段氏五主，甚見尊重。
units.en: He served five successive Duan lords and won deep respect.

units.zh: 段遼與皝相攻，裕諫曰：「臣聞親仁善鄰，國之寶也。
units.en: When Duan Liao and Murong Huang clashed, Yang Yu urged, “A state’s greatest treasure is to cherish kindness and befriend one’s neighbors.

units.zh: 慕容與國世為婚姻，且皝令德之主，不宜連兵構怨，凋殘百姓。
units.en: The Murong house and yours have intermarried for generations; Murong Huang is a man of virtue—you must not exhaust the people in vendetta.

units.zh: 臣恐禍害之興，將由於此。
units.en: I fear calamity will come of this feud.

units.zh: 願兩追前失，通款如初，使國家有太山之安，蒼生蒙息肩之惠。」
units.en: Let both sides remedy their former faults and renew good faith as at the beginning, so the state may have the security of Mount Tai and the common people receive the blessing of laying down their burdens.”

units.zh: 遼不從。
units.en: Duan Liao refused.

units.zh: 出為燕郡太守。
units.en: He left court to become grand warden of Yan commandery.

units.zh: 石季龍克令支，裕以郡降，拜北平太守，徵為尚書左丞。
units.en: When Shi Hu seized Lingzhi, Yang Yu surrendered his commandery, was named grand warden of Beiping, then recalled as left assistant in the secretariat.

units.zh: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
units.en: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu to send troops to receive him, Yang Yu, while serving as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.

units.zh: 秋敗，裕為軍人所執，將詣皝。
units.en: Ma Qiu’s defeat left Yang Yu a prisoner on his way to Murong Huang.

units.zh: 皝素聞裕名，即命釋其囚，拜郎中令，遷大將軍左司馬。
units.en: Murong Huang, who had long heard of Yu’s name, at once ordered his bonds released, appointed him Palace Director, then promoted him to Grand General’s Left Major.

units.zh: 東破高句麗，北滅宇文歸，皆豫其謀，皝甚器重之。
units.en: He helped plan the eastern victory over Goguryeo and the northern destruction of Yuwen Gui, and Huang came to rely on him heavily.

units.zh: 及遷都和龍，裕雅有巧思，皝所制城池宮闔，皆裕之規模。
units.en: When the capital shifted to Helong, Yang Yu’s engineering shaped every wall and tower Murong Huang built.

units.zh: 裕雖仕皝日近，寵秩在舊人之右，性謙恭清儉，剛簡慈篤，雖曆居朝端，若布衣之士。
units.en: Although Yang Yu served Huang and grew daily closer, with favor and rank above the old retainers, his nature was humble, respectful, pure and frugal, firm, simple, kind and earnest; though he repeatedly held posts at the apex of the court, he was like a scholar in plain cloth.

units.zh: 士大夫流亡羈絕者，莫不經營收葬，存恤孤遺，士無賢不肖皆傾身待之，是以所在推仰。
units.en: He buried exiles, aided their orphans, and honored every gentleman he met, winning universal esteem.

units.zh: 初，范陽盧諶每稱之曰：「吾及晉之清平，曆觀朝士多矣，忠清簡毅，篤信義烈，如陽士倫者，實亦未幾。」
units.en: Earlier, Lu Chen of Fanyang always praised him, saying, “I have lived through Jin’s clear peace and have broadly observed many court gentlemen; loyal, pure, concise and resolute, steadfast in faith and fierce in righteousness—men like Yang Shilun are in truth few.”

units.zh: 及死，皝甚悼之，時年六十二。
units.en: When he died at sixty-two, Murong Huang mourned him deeply.
